text: morning all -- dropped my access setup memo in the drive. tl;dr i think we should be setting Solvara up as buy-and-bill under Part B like the infusion products. sites of care purchase it, bill with a J-code at ASP+6, clean economics for the derm practices, they love it
also on abandonment -- easiest fix is just give everyone the copay card, even the Medicare folks, cuts abandonment hugely in the analogs ive seen. $0 OOP for everybody, done
aaron hold up. its self-injected, thats pharmacy benefit / Part D, theres no buy and bill. the patient does the shot at home, no site of care is buying or billing anything
product profile literally says subcutaneous, self-administered at home. no in-office administration = no medical benefit claim = no J-code, no ASP+6
hmm but biologic B runs on the medical benefit and thats the closest analog policy we have?
biologic B is infused in-office. different product, different route of administration. thats the whole reason its on the medical side. you cant lift its benefit design onto a self-injectable
and on the copay thing -- you literally cannot give a medicare patient a copay card, thats AKS, ask Roth. medicaid and tricare same. thats not a design choice, its federal law
